goal: Vision conveyor sort: belt feeds 3 cubes; Gemini classified colours ['red', 'green', 'blue']; Franka picks each at the sensor + routes to its colour bin {'Cube_1': '/World/Bin_red', 'Cube_2': '/World/Bin_green', 'Cube_3': '/World/Bin_blue'}.
code:
create_scene_baseline(table_size=[3.0, 1.0])

robot_wizard(robot_name="franka_panda", dest_path="/World/Franka", position=[0, 0, 0.75], orientation=[0.7071068, 0, 0, 0.7071068])

create_conveyor(prim_path="/World/ConveyorBelt", position=[0.0, 0.4, 0.78], size=[3.0, 0.4, 0.05], surface_velocity=[0.2, 0, 0])

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[-1.2, 0.4, 0.835], size=0.05)
for _api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI","PhysicsCollisionAPI","PhysicsMassAPI","PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name=_api)
create_material(material_path="/World/Mat_red_1", shader_type="OmniPBR", diffuse_color=[1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
assign_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", material_path="/World/Mat_red_1")
set_semantic_label(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", class_name="red", semantic_type="color")
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", material_name="rubber")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", attr_name="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", prim_type="Cube", position=[-1.0, 0.4, 0.835], size=0.05)
for _api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI","PhysicsCollisionAPI","PhysicsMassAPI","PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", schema_name=_api)
create_material(material_path="/World/Mat_green_2", shader_type="OmniPBR", diffuse_color=[0.0, 1.0, 0.0])
assign_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", material_path="/World/Mat_green_2")
set_semantic_label(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", class_name="green", semantic_type="color")
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", material_name="rubber")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", attr_name="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_3", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.8, 0.4, 0.835], size=0.05)
for _api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI","PhysicsCollisionAPI","PhysicsMassAPI","PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_3", schema_name=_api)
create_material(material_path="/World/Mat_blue_3", shader_type="OmniPBR", diffuse_color=[0.0, 0.0, 1.0])
assign_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_3", material_path="/World/Mat_blue_3")
set_semantic_label(prim_path="/World/Cube_3", class_name="blue", semantic_type="color")
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_3", material_name="rubber")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Cube_3", attr_name="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)

create_bin(prim_path="/World/Bin_red", position=[-0.3, -0.4, 0.75], size=[0.22, 0.22, 0.12])
create_bin(prim_path="/World/Bin_green", position=[0.0, -0.4, 0.75], size=[0.22, 0.22, 0.12])
create_bin(prim_path="/World/Bin_blue", position=[0.3, -0.4, 0.75], size=[0.22, 0.22, 0.12])

add_proximity_sensor(sensor_path="/World/PickSensor", position=[0.4, 0.4, 0.835], size=[0.06, 0.06, 0.06])

setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    robot_family="franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    sensor_path="/World/PickSensor",
    belt_path="/World/ConveyorBelt",
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_1","/World/Cube_2","/World/Cube_3"],
    destination_path="/World/Bin_red",
    color_routing={"red": "/World/Bin_red", "green": "/World/Bin_green", "blue": "/World/Bin_blue"},
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Table", "/World/ConveyorBelt"],
)
